title: Pull-request Turbo Write-through Cache Implementation Tasks
principles: Allow token-bearing pull requests to read and write deterministic Turbo results.
Keep fork pull requests secret-free with a complete local fallback.
Preserve live frozen installation instead of caching node_modules.
Keep cache evidence separate from release and provider proof.

globalVerification.commitPolicy: Commit only after focused policy, documentation, repository and empty-token fallback checks pass; use the pull request and exact rerun for hosted write/read proof.
evidenceRequired: Same-repository pull-request read/write mode with a Vercel remote write followed by an exact-rerun hit.
Fork-equivalent empty-token local fallback without a shortened Quality graph.
Preserved node_modules prohibition and measured warm-install rationale.
Exact immutable revision, run and bounded non-claims.

downstreamArtifactImpact.verification: bun run check:quality-workflow and bun run test:quality-workflow
nonClaims: Local policy checks do not prove a hosted Vercel write or hit.

downstreamArtifactImpact.verification: bun run check:docs, bun run check:runbooks and bun run verification
Negative policy fixture rejects node_modules and live frozen install remains present.
nonClaims: No package version, runtime or publication change is implied.

tasks.title: Enable and prove pull-request Turbo writes
tasks.goal: Let same-repository pull requests populate Vercel Remote Cache while fork pull requests retain secret-free local fallback.
scope: current CI architecture, standards, authority and runbook owners
outputs: one read/write Turbo mode for token-bearing Quality runs
policy fixtures for write-through, fork safety and node_modules prohibition
completed lifecycle record with bounded node_modules decision
tasks.implementationPrompt: Replace the Quality pull-request remote read-only mode with read/write. Do not use pull_request_target, expand repository permissions or expose the token to forks. Keep all cache misses non-fatal and every Quality command live. Preserve Bun's package-download cache, the separate Chromium cache, bun install --frozen-lockfile, Playwright --with-deps and the node_modules rejection. Update executable governance and the earliest durable docs owners. Prove one pull-request write and exact-rerun hit before closeout.
mandatoryVerification: hosted pull-request run and exact rerun
qualityAudits: Confirm pull_request remains the only pull-request trigger and repository permissions remain contents read.
Confirm every node_modules cache mutation still fails policy.
Match hosted claims to the exact immutable revision and Turbo task logs.
Review the final diff for unrelated package, deployment, provider or credential changes.

parentAudit.basis: Review the accepted risk, exact workflow policy, empty-token fallback, hosted write/read result and documentation impact ledger.
parentAudit.recovery: Restore pull requests to remote read-only or remove remote bindings while retaining the complete local graph.

completionCriteria: A same-repository pull-request run writes a deterministic Turbo result and its exact rerun reads it remotely.
Fork-equivalent fallback and the node_modules prohibition remain enforced.
The completed record includes exact run evidence, rollback, limitations and no-Changeset rationale.
